items.name: NexQL
items.tagline: AI-native Postgres tooling, All in VS Code
items.description: NexQL is a PostgreSQL extension for VS Code combining a full database toolkit — tree explorer, SQL notebooks, visual designers, live dashboards. Every suggestion lands in a notebook cell for you to review and run. Production connections default to read-only, with risk scoring and environment tagging. Free AI models included, no API key needed. MCP model for advanced tooling with Copilot / Claude / Antigravity / Cursor / etc. Core is free and MIT-licensed.

items.name: Sabertario
items.tagline: Free courses and tutorials, organized by category
items.description: Sabertario is a free directory that collects courses, tutorials and guides already scattered across the internet — coding, languages, cooking, beekeeping, sign language, bookbinding, and more — organized into 35+ categories. No sign-up, no paywall, just curated links to real free resources.

items.name: Hackathon Radar
items.tagline: The world's most comprehensive hackathon database
items.description: HackathonRadar helps developers, students, organisers, sponsors and judges discover hackathons from around the world in one place. We aggregate events from dozens of sources, deduplicate listings, and surface opportunities you won't find elsewhere. Search by location, date, technology, format and prizes, save personalised alerts, and never miss another hackathon. We currently track an estimated 96% of the public hackathon ecosystem.

items.name: Whopmail
items.description: The email, automation & AI platform built for Whop creators — every signup, payment, and cancellation triggers the right message, automatically.

items.name: VoteGrid
items.tagline: Compare election candidates side by side - unfiltered & free
items.description: VoteGrid lets voters compare election candidates side by side. Every candidate answers the same questions in the same format — no spin, no bias, no editorial filter. Information comes straight from the candidates themselves. The goal is simple: make informed voting easier and get more people to participate.

items.name: AI Chat Exporter
items.tagline: Batch Export & sync your content to Notion & Obsidian
items.description: Sync ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to Notion / Obsidian in one click, or export private PDF, DOCX, Markdown and more.

items.name: ERPnBox
items.tagline: Your Business, Unboxed all 12 apps, set up by AI in minutes.
items.description: Your Business, Unboxed. Anyone can generate a CRM — almost nobody can generate the system behind it: a real ledger under the invoice, payroll under the employee, a shared WhatsApp inbox that writes to the same records. ERPnBox is twelve apps on one record set: CRM, finance, HR and payroll, support, live chat, bookings, campaigns, forms and your website. Describe what you do at 9:00 — it's running by 9:07. All 12 apps, AI included, one price. Web and mobile. Free to try, no credit card.

items.name: Reviscio
items.tagline: The first AI study app for quizzes, flashcards, exams & more
items.description: Most students don’t lack resources—they drown in them, juggling notes, flashcards, past papers, and AI across five tabs. Reviscio unites your entire revision workflow in one free AI platform. Generate instant quizzes, master exam questions, and lock in daily study habits with streaks, XP, and seasonal rewards.

items.name: Mojiyomi

items.description: Instantly extract text from images and PDFs with high-accuracy AI-OCR! Mojiyomi is an AI-powered text recognition and transcription tool designed to easily streamline tedious typing and document digitization.
